name: Outfitter
description: Install it and you have a merch store. No theme, no build.

images.title: Build every page from sections
images.description: Arrange the home, product and category pages from seventeen section types. Drag to reorder, hide without deleting, preview on any screen.

images.title: Edit the words on the page itself
images.description: Click any line of your store's copy and type over it, or set it in the section's settings. All 143 strings, in every language you sell in.

images.title: Sizes, colors and the photo to match
images.description: Size and color pick the variant, a color can carry its own photo, and add-ons are priced per option all the way to the order.

images.title: Seven colors, the whole store follows
images.description: Set a palette, logo and store name once. Buttons, text and every hairline pick it up, shown against the default the store installs with.
